changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ReportResponsibility') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[ReportResponsibility]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ReportID] [int] NOT NULL, [ResponsibilityTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ReportResponsibility] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) )
END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_ReportResponsibility_Report') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[ReportResponsibility] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_ReportResponsibility_Report] FOREIGN KEY([ReportID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Report] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[ReportResponsibility] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_ReportResponsibility_Report] END
